items.line: You can now freeze your card from the app (ACME-101, cards-2026.10.2).
Statement PDFs now show the minimum payment (ACME-102).
Credit limit increase eligibility check is complete and waiting for release (ACME-104).
Declined payments now trigger a push notification (ACME-105, cards-2026.10.3).
Card replacement fee copy was updated (ACME-106).

humanise.before: Released on 22 Oct 2026 in cards-2026.10.2: ACME-101 card freeze, ACME-102 statement minimum payment. Released on 25 Oct 2026 in cards-2026.10.3: ACME-105 declined-payment push for 100% of customers.
humanise.after: On 22 Oct 2026 we shipped cards-2026.10.2 with card freeze (ACME-101) and the minimum payment on statements (ACME-102). On 25 Oct 2026, cards-2026.10.3 added a push for declined payments (ACME-105), live for 100% of customers.
